title: Grateful Dead Live at Hill Auditorium on 1971-12-15

ai_review.summary: Tight, high‑energy December ’71 first set captured on a crisp soundboard mix with only minor hiss and occasional muddiness.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the superbly tight performance of this December 1971 show – calling it “ridiculously tight” and the best of the year – while praising the clear soundboard mix. A few listeners note a bit of hiss on the quiet "Brokedown Palace" and some mild muddiness, but overall the recording is very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars highlighting excellent performance and good soundboard quality; only a single low‑mid rating notes minor recording flaws, leading to a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix praised by several reviewers; occasional hiss on the quiet "Brokedown Palace" and mild distortion/muddiness noted but still very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is considered the stronger of the two available versions; reviewers recommend pairing it with the missing second set from another source.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s presence is highlighted and praised by fans.
